facts.text: If you do not have a driver's license from California or another state, you must apply for an instruction permit before taking the behind-the-wheel drive test.

cites.quote: If you do not have a driver’s license from California or another state, you must apply for an instruction permit before taking the behind-the-wheel drive test

facts.text: To apply for an instruction permit or driver's license, you must provide proof of identity.

cites.quote: To apply for an instruction permit or driver’s license, you must provide:
Proof of identity: Proving who you are.

facts.text: To apply for an instruction permit or driver's license, you must provide two proofs of California residency (exceptions may apply).

cites.quote: To apply for an instruction permit or driver’s license, you must provide:
Two proofs of residency: Proving you live in California. Exceptions may apply.

facts.text: When applying for a permit or license, you must provide a legal full name document if the name on your identity document does not match the name on your application.

cites.quote: To apply for an instruction permit or driver’s license, you must provide:
Legal full name document: Proving your current name if the name on your identity document and application do not match.

facts.text: To apply for an instruction permit or driver's license, you must provide your social security number (exceptions may apply).

cites.quote: To apply for an instruction permit or driver’s license, you must provide:
Social security number: Exceptions may apply.

facts.text: To apply for a Class C instruction permit, you must complete a Driver's License & ID Card Application and provide your documents.

cites.quote: To apply for a Class C instruction permit:
Complete a Driver’s License & ID Card Application.
Provide your documents.

facts.text: The application fee for a Class C instruction permit is non-refundable.

cites.quote: To apply for a Class C instruction permit:
Pay a non-refundable application fee.

facts.text: To get a Class C instruction permit, you must pass the knowledge test(s).

cites.quote: To apply for a Class C instruction permit:
Pass your knowledge test(s).

facts.text: To get a Class C instruction permit, you must pass a vision test.

cites.quote: To apply for a Class C instruction permit:
Pass a vision test.

facts.text: If you are under 18, you must be at least 15½ years old to apply for an instruction permit.

cites.quote: If you are under 18 years old, you will also need to:
Be at least 15½ years old.

facts.text: If you are under 18, you must complete a driver education program to get an instruction permit.

cites.quote: If you are under 18 years old, you will also need to:
Complete a driver education program.

facts.text: If you are under 18, a parent or guardian must sign your permit application, approving it and accepting financial responsibility.

cites.quote: If you are under 18 years old, you will also need to:
Have a parent or guardian sign to approve the application and accept financial responsibility

facts.text: If your parents or guardians share joint custody of you, both must sign your application.

cites.quote: If your parents or guardians share joint custody of you, both must sign.

facts.text: If you are under 18, you may not use your instruction permit until you start behind-the-wheel driver training with an instructor, who will validate the permit.

cites.quote: If you are under 18 years old, you will also need to:
Wait to use your instruction permit until you start behind-the-wheel driver training with an instructor who will validate the permit.

facts.text: Driver education and driver training are offered at DMV-licensed driving schools and some high schools.

cites.quote: Driver education and driver training are offered at DMV-licensed driving schools and some high schools.

facts.text: Driving instructors must carry an instructor's ID card, and you may ask to see it.

cites.quote: Instructors must carry an instructor’s ID card. Ask to see it.

facts.text: When practicing with an instruction permit, you must drive with a California-licensed driver who is at least 18 years old, or at least 25 if you are a minor.

cites.quote: To get your driver’s license after you have your instruction permit, you need to:
Practice driving with a California-licensed driver who is at least 18 years old (25 for minors).

facts.text: The licensed driver supervising a permit holder must sit close enough to take control of the vehicle if needed.

cites.quote: This person must sit close enough to take control of the vehicle if needed.

facts.text: After getting your instruction permit, you must pass a behind-the-wheel drive test to get your driver's license.

cites.quote: To get your driver’s license after you have your instruction permit, you need to:
Pass a behind-the-wheel drive test.

facts.text: If you are under 18, you must be at least 16 years old to get a driver's license.

cites.quote: If you are under 18 years old, you will also need to:
Be at least 16 years old.

facts.text: If you are under 18, you must have held an instruction permit (from California or another state) for at least 6 months, or turn 18, before scheduling your behind-the-wheel drive test.

cites.quote: If you are under 18 years old, you will also need to:
Have an instruction permit from California or another state for at least 6 months (or turn 18 years old) before scheduling your behind-the-wheel drive test.

facts.text: If you are under 18, you must prove you completed both driver education and driver training to get a driver's license.

cites.quote: If you are under 18 years old, you will also need to:
Prove that you completed both driver education and driver training.

facts.text: If you are under 18, you must practice driving for at least 50 hours with a California-licensed driver who is at least 25 years old before getting your license.

cites.quote: If you are under 18 years old, you will also need to:
Practice driving for at least 50 hours with a California-licensed driver who is at least 25 years old.

facts.text: At least 10 of a minor's 50 required practice hours must be driven at night.

cites.quote: Ten hours must be at night.

facts.text: If you are under 18, your driver's license is a provisional license.

cites.quote: When you are under 18 years old, your driver’s license will have the word provisional.

facts.text: As a provisional driver, you cannot drive between 11 p.m. and 5 a.m. during the first 12 months you have your license.

cites.quote: As a provisional driver, you cannot drive:
Between 11 p.m. and 5 a.m. during the first 12 months you have your license.

facts.text: As a provisional driver, you cannot drive with passengers under 20 years old unless your parent or guardian or another California-licensed driver at least 25 years old rides with you.

cites.quote: As a provisional driver, you cannot drive:
With passengers under 20 years old, unless your parent or guardian or other California-licensed driver (at least 25 years old) rides with you.

facts.text: As a provisional driver, you cannot drive for pay or operate vehicles that require a commercial Class A, B, or C license.

cites.quote: As a provisional driver, you cannot drive:
For pay or operate vehicles that require a commercial Class A, B, or C license.

facts.text: A provisional driver may be excused from the restrictions for a medical need, if there is no reasonable other way to travel, and must carry a physician-signed note giving the medical condition and expected recovery date.

cites.quote: There are exceptions to these restrictions if you:
Have a medical need and cannot reasonably find another way to travel. You must carry a note signed by your physician. The note must have your medical condition and date you are expected to recover.

facts.text: A provisional driver may be excused from the restrictions to drive for schooling or a school activity, and must carry a note signed by the school principal, dean, or designee.

cites.quote: There are exceptions to these restrictions if you:
Drive for schooling or a school activity. You must carry a note signed by your school principal, dean, or designee.

facts.text: A provisional driver may be excused from the restrictions to drive for work, and must carry a note signed by the employer confirming the employment.

cites.quote: There are exceptions to these restrictions if you:
Must drive for work reasons. You must carry a note signed by your employer. The note must confirm your employment.

facts.text: A provisional driver may be excused from the restrictions to drive an immediate family member, and must carry a note signed by a parent or legal guardian stating the reason, the family member, and when the need will end.

cites.quote: There are exceptions to these restrictions if you:

Must drive an immediate family member. You must carry a note signed by your parent or legal guardian. The note must state the reason you need to drive, the family member, and date when the need will end.

facts.text: A parent or guardian may cancel their teen's driver's license by completing a Request for Cancellation or Surrender of a Driver License or ID Card form.

cites.quote: A parent or guardian may cancel their teen’s license by completing a Request for Cancellation or Surrender of a Driver License or ID Card form.
